title: DHoster
tagline: It is a decentralized  web hosting platform for static web page...
description: DHoster is a decentralized web hosting platform. You can host your static web page and get a link to their web page.  It is deployed on Polygon Network. You also get metadata of that web page. First, you have to connect your wallet and then start to paste your HTML file then you get the URL of your webpage and you share your webpage with others also.
how_its_made: DHoster is deployed on a polygon network. The fronted part is made of by HTML, CSS, and javascript, and the backend part is done by Moralis.  All data are stored on IPFS. Web hosting is done by IPFS.  It is totally decentralized and all metadata is stored on IPFS.Url is also provided by IPFS.
